note: Important dates for the Class of 2027 advisory calendar. Exact and priority dates may appear in the confirmed calendar. Pattern dates are planning reminders based on a prior cycle and stay out of the confirmed calendar until re-confirmed.

events.name: Common App opens
events.description: First-year application for most out-of-state and private colleges goes live.

events.name: SAT registration deadline (Aug 22 test)
events.description: Regular registration deadline for the August 22, 2026 SAT.

events.name: SAT test date (Sept 12)
events.description: SAT administration.

events.name: SAT test date (Oct 3)
events.description: SAT administration.

events.name: FAFSA expected to open
events.description: Planning date for the 2027–28 FAFSA. Confirm the live form before relying on this date, then submit as early as practical.

events.name: WASFA expected to open
events.description: Planning date for the 2027–28 WASFA. Use WSAC's official guidance to decide whether FAFSA or WASFA is the appropriate application.

events.name: WWU Early Action deadline
events.description: Western Washington University early action deadline for priority scholarship consideration.

events.name: SAT test date (Nov 7)
events.description: SAT administration.

events.name: UW Bothell / UW Tacoma Early Action deadline
events.description: Early action deadline for UW Bothell and UW Tacoma.

events.name: University of Washington Seattle application deadline
events.description: First-year application deadline for the University of Washington Seattle campus.

events.name: Recommendation letter request cutoff
events.description: Not an official deadline—but asking teachers for recommendation letters before Thanksgiving break helps avoid rushed winter-break requests.

events.name: Confirm dual-credit (Tech Prep/CTE) articulation before term ends
events.description: Confirm with the CTE teacher before the term ends that the course still has an active dual-credit articulation agreement and that the paperwork will go to the college.

events.name: YVC Foundation scholarship application opens
events.description: Yakima Valley College Foundation scholarship application window opens.

events.name: Evergreen State College application deadline
events.description: The Evergreen State College application deadline.

events.name: SAT test date (Dec 5)
events.description: SAT administration.

events.name: UW Bothell / UW Tacoma Regular Decision deadline
events.description: Regular decision deadline for UW Bothell and UW Tacoma.

events.name: WWU Regular Decision + financial-aid priority deadline
events.description: Western Washington University regular decision deadline and priority date for financial-aid and scholarship review.

events.name: WSU FAFSA/WASFA + General Scholarship priority deadline
events.description: Priority deadline for WSU's general scholarship application and for FAFSA/WASFA to be considered for WSU aid. This is separate from WSU's March 31 admission priority date.

events.name: Washington College Grant priority planning reminder
events.description: Each college may use a different financial-aid priority date. File FAFSA or WASFA as early as practical and check every college's own date; this reminder is not one statewide deadline.

events.name: EWU priority application deadline
events.description: Eastern Washington University priority application deadline.

events.name: SAT registration deadline (March 6 test)
events.description: Regular registration deadline for the March 6, 2027 SAT.

events.name: YVC Foundation scholarship deadline
events.description: Yakima Valley College Foundation scholarship deadline—last day of February. Confirm the new cycle's exact date when the application opens.

events.name: CWU priority application deadline
events.description: Central Washington University priority application deadline.

events.name: WAEF scholarship deadline (last cycle: March 2)
events.description: Washington Apple Education Foundation deadline—the application that can unlock employer-specific tree-fruit-company funds. Confirm the exact 2027 date closer to January.

events.name: WSU admission priority deadline
events.description: WSU priority date for admission and automatic academic awards. Apply after this date and those specific awards may no longer be available.

events.name: NCAA final amateurism certification window
events.description: Student-athletes planning to compete at the D1 or D2 level need final transcript and amateurism steps completed before enrollment. Confirm the exact date with the NCAA Eligibility Center.

events.name: National College Decision Day / enrollment deposit due
events.description: Enrollment confirmation deposit is due at nearly every school. Missing this can mean losing the spot.

events.name: Housing deposit / priority housing deadline
events.description: Housing forms and deposits are separate from the enrollment deposit. Check the chosen college's housing page so the student does not end up enrolled without a housing assignment.

events.name: College Bound senior requirements check
events.description: End-of-school-year planning checkpoint—not an official WSAC deadline. Confirm FAFSA or WASFA completion and all College Bound requirements with WSAC and the student's college.

events.name: Final transcript must be sent
events.description: Nearly every admission offer is conditional on the final official transcript being sent after graduation. Verify the exact date with each student's chosen college.

events.name: Immunization records due before move-in
events.description: Housing and health requirements vary by college. Check the chosen college's health-services page before move-in.
